No. 0417Commission

Letter of Commission

  1. i.The atelier shall engrave and print one edition of forty plates on laid paper.
  2. ii.The undersigned shall pay on delivery, and keep the proofs.
Signature16 · X · 2026

# ink-pad A signature field, or a page of margin notes, that writes like a pointed dip pen on good paper. Downstrokes swell and upstrokes run to a hairline; ink pools where the nib touches down, lifts slowly or rests, and keeps spreading while you hold still. Fresh ink is darker, cooler and glossy; each point dries on its own clock over about two seconds, so a long stroke dries from where it began toward the pen, and the pools dry last. Clear presses a blotter onto the page and lifts the ink away. It is a real form control: required, validatable, resettable, with a typed-name alternative for keyboards. ```html
``` Without JS the fallback field is the control, so the form still works. With JS it becomes the "Type instead" field, and the form gets the drawing as an SVG string in an input named `data-name`. Margin notes over a printed page: author the surface yourself and the image inside it is the paper. ```html
``` Or `import { inkPad } from './ink-pad.js'` and call `inkPad(el, options)`. It returns `destroy()`, which also carries `.undo()`, `.redo()`, `.clear(instant)`, `.toSVG()`, `.toPNG()` and `.isEmpty()`. ## Options | data- attribute | option | default | | |-------------------|------------|-----------------------------|---| | `data-name` | `name` | the fallback input's name | name of the input that receives the SVG | | `data-png-name` | `pngName` | none | also write a PNG data URL (transparent, 2x) to a hidden input of this name | | `data-required` | `required` | off | an empty pad blocks submit, marks the line and takes focus | | `data-variant` | `variant` | `signature` | `signature` (baseline and ×) or `margin` (no furniture, finer nib, no typed mode) | | `data-size` | `size` | `4` (margin `2.8`) | nib size: hairlines are ~0.15x, full downstrokes ~1.2x | | `data-dry` | `dry` | `2000` | ms for ink to dry; pools take up to twice as long | | `data-typed` | `typed` | on for signature | `false` removes the "Type instead" alternative | | `data-mode` | `mode` | `auto` | `annotate`: on touch screens a pen switch decides whether a finger writes or scrolls. `auto` does that only when the pad is taller than 55% of the viewport. `draw`: a finger always writes | | `data-label` | `label` | `Signature` / `Margin notes`| accessible name of the pad | | `data-ink` | `ink` | `--ip-ink` | dry ink colour | | `data-wet` | `wet` | `--ip-ink-wet` | wet ink colour | Events: the value input fires `input` and `change` (both bubble, so a form listener sees them) after every stroke, undo, redo and clear; typing fires `input` per letter and `change` when the field commits. Form `reset` clears the pad. ## Theming | variable | default | | |--------------------|--------------------|---| | `--ip-ink` | `#1a1714` | dry ink, a warm near-black | | `--ip-ink-wet` | derived from ink | fresh ink; the default is a deeper blue-black, as iron-gall goes on | | `--ip-sheen` | `#fffaf0` | the highlight on wet ink | | `--ip-paper` | transparent | background of the surface (a paper texture works well) | | `--ip-line-y` | `70%` | where the baseline sits | | `--ip-rule` | `--ink-3` | baseline colour | | `--ip-blotter` | `#ead8cd` | blotting-paper colour | | `--ip-blotter-image` | none | blotter texture, multiplied over the colour | | `--ip-script` | `"Mrs Saint Delafield", cursive` | face for typed signatures (load it yourself) | Also uses the house `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--ink-3`, `--rule`, `--accent`, `--serif`, `--sans`. The signature surface is `aspect-ratio: 2/1` on phones and `3/1` from 640px; set your own on `.ip-surface`. ## Tuning notes - Pressure. A pointed nib's weight is about direction: the tines spread only when pulled down along the slant (`NIB`, down and a little left), so upstrokes and horizontals are hairlines and downstrokes swell. Fingers and mice get that from direction, trimmed a little by speed; a real pen's pressure is multiplied in. Contrast is `PF.thinning` and the `dirF` / `speedF` lines in `extend()`. - Pools: `DWELL` (150ms within 1.4px before ink pools), the growth constant in `growPool()`, and `poolR()` for size. - The sheen is drawn along the centre line, offset toward the light (`LIGHT`, upper left), strongest where the stroke's side faces the light. - Only wet ink is redrawn each frame; dry strokes are baked once, oldest first. The loop stops when everything is dry or the pad is off screen. - The SVG is the dry ink: one `` per stroke (perfect-freehand's outline) plus a `` per pool, in a group at 0.93 opacity so overlaps don't double. A typed signature is a `` in the script face; the font is not embedded, so ask for the PNG too if the image must be exact. - Ink is stored relative to the pad width, so it scales with the pad. ## Touch, keyboard, accessibility - One finger draws; the page doesn't scroll under it (`touch-action: none`). Two fingers scroll the page (a stroke only just begun is cancelled). Once a pen has been used, other touches are ignored as palm. Scrolling elsewhere is untouched. - Big surfaces on touch screens (`data-mode="annotate"`, or taller than 55% of the viewport) don't trap the page. A nib button (`aria-pressed`) appears in the bar. Off: a finger scrolls, and a tap shows "Tap the pen to write" and nods the nib. On: one finger writes, the edge of the surface warms, and it turns itself off after 8s without a stroke or when scrolled mostly out of view. A stylus always writes; a mouse always draws. - The pad is focusable, labelled and described. Enter or any letter switches to typing; Escape in the field goes back to drawing. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes and Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z redoes (when the pad has focus, or was the last thing touched). Undo also brings back a clear. Changes are announced politely. - Validation: the value input is a real, visually hidden `` with `required`, so `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()` and submit all see it. When it is invalid the line and × turn accent, a short message appears and the pad takes focus. - Reduced motion: ink lands dry, and Clear is instant. Drawing is unchanged. - Decoration (line, ×, canvases, blotter) is `aria-hidden`. ## The demo A letter of commission on laid paper (chain and laid lines are CSS gradients over a fine paper tooth high-passed from a linen photograph), signed in iron-gall ink; a valid submit presses a clay seal and locks the pad with `inert`. Below, a naturalist's plate (one of two, picked per visit) shown in grey until your first note in red-brown ink, when it blooms into colour (demo CSS on `.has-ink`). The blotter is a handmade Büttenpapier scan, flattened and mirrored into a seamless tile. ## Credits - [perfect-freehand](https://github.com/steveruizok/perfect-freehand) by Steve Ruiz, MIT, in `vendor/perfect-freehand/`. - Mrs Saint Delafield by Alejandro Paul (Sudtipos), SIL Open Font License, via Google Fonts (demo only). - Images from Wikimedia Commons, see `assets/credits.json`.
